data.text: I’ll join Kate and Emma: 15 tons this month, all $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, and no more than 6 tons next month—provided John agrees and everyone keeps these pledges, including Luke’s zero catch. My family’s livelihood depends on this lake, but our neighbors need treatment today. Let’s record the catches and clinic payments afterward, and keep the recovery limit firm before returning to 10 tons each. John, your agreement is the last piece—will you join us?
